savollar.savol: Radiusi 6 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 60° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 10 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 90° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 5 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 180° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 12 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 30° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 9 cm bo'lgan sektorning yoyi uzunligi 6π sm ga teng. Sektor yuzini S = Rl/2 formula orqali toping.
Radiusi 8 cm bo'lgan doiraning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 4 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 270° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 7 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 360° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 8 cm, yoyining gradus o'lchovi 45° bo'lgan sektorning yuzini toping.
Yoyining gradus o'lchovi 90° bo'lgan sektorning yuzi 9π ga teng. Sektor radiusini toping.
Yoyning gradus o'lchovi 60° bo'lgan sektorning yuzi 54π ga teng. Sektor radiusini toping.
Radiusi 10 cm, markaziy burchagi 90° bo'lgan kichik segmentning yuzini toping (sin90° = 1).
Radiusi 6 cm, markaziy burchagi 60° bo'lgan kichik segmentning yuzini toping (sin60° = √3/2).
Radiusi 8 cm bo'lgan doirada markaziy burchagi 180° bo'lgan segmentning yuzini toping.
Radiusi 6 cm bo'lgan doirada kichik yoyga mos markaziy burchak 90°. Shu vatarga mos katta segmentning yuzini toping (sin90° = 1).
Radiusi 10 cm bo'lgan doirada sektor yuzi butun doira yuzining 1/4 qismiga teng. Sektorning markaziy burchagini toping.
Birinchi sektor: R1 = 4 cm, n1 = 90°; ikkinchi sektor: R2 = 8 cm, n2 = 45°. Ularning yuzlari nisbatini toping.
Radiusi 12 cm bo'lgan doirada sektor yuzi 24π ga teng. Sektor yoyining uzunligini S = Rl/2 formula orqali toping.
Radiusi 6 cm bo'lgan doirada sektor yuzi butun doira yuzidan 15π kam. Sektorning markaziy burchagini toping.
Radiusi 9 cm, markaziy burchagi 120° bo'lgan kichik segmentning yuzini toping (sin120° = √3/2).
